scope: Bounded diploid quantitative-genetics primitives plus numeric distance matrices. Partial JMP Life Sciences/GBLUP method coverage; no polyploid or phased linked breeding workflow.

common_contract.inputs: Finite rectangular nonempty matrix,<=100000rows,<=1024columns,<=1Mcells; method limits tighter. Genotypes encode allele dosage0,1,2,missing -1; dosage-capable methods accept continuous[0,2].
common_contract.missing: SQL NULL remains invalid by common FFI contract; explicit -1 is genotype missing code. Unsupervised imputation/relatedness fit all supplied rows. GBLUP fits prefix only and ignores suffix outcomes.
common_contract.portable: Only mean/mode marker imputation saves query-only replacement values. LD-kNN and stochastic imputation are transductive, not deployable inductive models. GBLUP saves stable origin/offset markers and effects.
common_contract.statistics: HWE Pearson df1 is asymptotic, not exact; all-missing and monomorphic loci have null inferential quantities; BH adjusts only identifiable loci.
common_contract.verification: Public Rust behavior tests GREEN; production exported C ABI independent references PASS: 853 cases/137076 numerical fields; native SQL gate pending.

operations.description: Diploid genotype call rows (individuals x markers); 0/1/2,missing=-1; []. Call rates, allele/MAF/heterozygosity/PIC, asymptotic Pearson HWE df1 and BH p-values; monomorphic/all-missing HWE null.
unsupported: REML variance-component fitting and GWAS tests
identical JMP imputation random streams or LD-kNN tie/fallback conventions
